description:
Two related caching features:

1. **OpenAI prompt caching**: `prompt_cache_key` and `prompt_cache_retention: "24h"` params, only for `api.openai.com` hosts.

2. **Anthropic-style cache control** (via OpenRouter): when `cache_control_format: :anthropic`, add `cache_control: {type: "ephemeral"}` markers to system prompt, last tool definition, and last conversation message. TTL `"1h"` only for `api.anthropic.com`.

Upstream: openai-completions.ts L475-477, L567-681
Port map: §8
title: Prompt caching + Anthropic-style cache control
